crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
translations.bsb: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.
translations.kjv: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
translations.asv: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their garments.
